title: Gane language
description: Austronesian language spoken in North Maluku, Indonesia
extract: Gane is an Austronesian language of southern Halmahera, Indonesia, spoken by the Gane people. There are estimated to be roughly 5800 native speakers of the language. It is closely related to the Taba language.
